description: Claim-to-citation binding conformance cases for `hwspecs resolve` (synthetic widget device). Each case is one fact in widget.spec.yaml.in; findings lists the expected findings for that fact in order, without --strict-claims and with it. A finding's message is '<fact id>: ' followed by text matching message_pattern.

cases.description: Hex literal on a cited line that shares an identifier with its sentence.
Unrelated-hex false match: 0x40 is in the cited lines, but only on a line about another device.

findings.message_pattern: claim hex values not bound to a cited line sharing an identifier with their sentence: 0x40$

strict_findings.message_pattern: claim hex values not bound to a cited line sharing an identifier with their sentence: 0x40$

cases.description: The nearest preceding line ending in '{' supplies the shared identifier.
The anchor symbol supplies the shared identifier.
Range end present and its successor absent.
Off-by-one range end: the backticked end identifier is absent.

findings.message_pattern: claim identifier range WPIN0\.\.WPIN4: end identifier WPIN4 absent from cited text$

strict_findings.message_pattern: claim identifier range WPIN0\.\.WPIN4: end identifier WPIN4 absent from cited text$

cases.description: Successor present: the identifier after the range end is in the cited text.

findings.message_pattern: claim identifier range WPIN0\.\.WPIN2: successor WPIN3 present in cited text$

strict_findings.message_pattern: claim identifier range WPIN0\.\.WPIN2: successor WPIN3 present in cited text$

cases.description: Successor finding suppressed when another range in the claim starts there.
ngpios value appears literally in the cited DT lines.
ngpios mismatch between claim and cited DT lines.

findings.message_pattern: claim ngpios = <18> absent from cited text$

strict_findings.message_pattern: claim ngpios = <18> absent from cited text$
